notes.BRA: 跨國電廠依份額拆開：伊泰普水電廠（與巴拉圭共有）算 50%。
notes.PRY: 跨國電廠依份額拆開：伊泰普水電廠（與巴西共有）算 50%；亞西雷塔水電廠（與阿根廷共有）算 50%。
notes.ARG: 跨國電廠依份額拆開：亞西雷塔水電廠（與巴拉圭共有）算 50%；薩爾托格蘭德水電廠（與烏拉圭共有）算 50%。
notes.URY: 跨國電廠依份額拆開：薩爾托格蘭德水電廠（與阿根廷共有）算 50%。
notes.ROU: 跨國電廠依份額拆開：鐵門一號水電廠（與塞爾維亞共有）算 50%；鐵門二號水電廠（與塞爾維亞共有）算 50%。
notes.SRB: 跨國電廠依份額拆開：鐵門一號水電廠（與羅馬尼亞共有）算 50%；鐵門二號水電廠（與羅馬尼亞共有）算 50%。
notes.ZMB: 跨國電廠依份額拆開：卡里巴水壩水電廠（與辛巴威共有）算 51%。
notes.ZWE: 跨國電廠依份額拆開：卡里巴水壩水電廠（與尚比亞共有）算 49%。
notes.TWN: GEM（2026 年 9 月）台灣運轉中的水力（含抽蓄）電廠合計 4,480 MW；能源署統計 2025 年（民國 114 年）底水力（含抽蓄） 4,726 MW（台電 4,678、民營電廠 44、自用發電設備 4）。兩者都含抽蓄水力（明潭、大觀二廠）；GEM 只收 30 MW 以上的水力電廠。

notesEn.BRA: Cross-border plants are split by share: Itaipu (shared with Paraguay) counts 50%.
notesEn.PRY: Cross-border plants are split by share: Itaipu (shared with Brazil) counts 50%; Yacyretá (shared with Argentina) counts 50%.
notesEn.ARG: Cross-border plants are split by share: Yacyretá (shared with Paraguay) counts 50%; Salto Grande (shared with Uruguay) counts 50%.
notesEn.URY: Cross-border plants are split by share: Salto Grande (shared with Argentina) counts 50%.
notesEn.ROU: Cross-border plants are split by share: Iron Gate I (shared with Serbia) counts 50%; Iron Gate II (shared with Serbia) counts 50%.
notesEn.SRB: Cross-border plants are split by share: Iron Gate I (shared with Romania) counts 50%; Iron Gate II (shared with Romania) counts 50%.
notesEn.ZMB: Cross-border plants are split by share: Kariba Dam (shared with Zimbabwe) counts 51%.
notesEn.ZWE: Cross-border plants are split by share: Kariba Dam (shared with Zambia) counts 49%.
notesEn.TWN: GEM (September 2026) lists 4,480 MW of operating hydro (incl. pumped storage) capacity in Taiwan; the Energy Administration reports 4,726 MW of hydro (incl. pumped storage) at the end of 2025 (Taipower 4,678, independent producers 44, self-generation 4). Both include pumped storage (Mingtan, Taikuan II); GEM only covers hydro plants of 30 MW or more.
